rules.rule: Coverage is per route and per driven control
must: coverage is per route, from specs that drive it
The route — never the spec file — is the unit of work

rules.rule: Every new test is shown red with its behaviour broken
must: A test that stays green with its behaviour broken asserts nothing

rules.rule: Extend the fake, never the app, to serve a route
must: Never change the app server or the frontend to suit the fake
Never change a record an\s+existing spec or test asserts on; add new ones

rules.rule: Go edits to the fake follow go:style
Projects needing credentials or live services are never run
must: A project\s+that needs credentials or a live external service is never run

rules.rule: A red baseline stops the run before any edit
must: Red: stop and report the failures, editing nothing

rules.rule: Unrecognized tokens are named and defaults run; an empty target resolution asks
must: Read the tokens in any order: a reserved word is a mode or flag, `key=value`\s+is a control, and anything else is the target
say it was not\s+recognized, name the ones that exist, and run with the defaults as if it were absent
A target\s+that resolves to nothing: say so and ask — never guess what to work on

rules.rule: max= is a hard cap on tests added; what is left is reported
must: `max=N` — hard cap on tests added \(one per new `test`\)
